commit.message:
C260: freeze reviewed finite hinge-observation contract

Define source/artifact field origins, literal signed-basis and angle subset, explicit refusal and authority limits, and 28 future unrun control groups. Preserve both contract-review findings and original draft bytes. Independent review approves exact contract39bf90c5; clean candidate documentation and C253 manifest checks pass. No reader implementation, runtime or workflow change. Scope #247.

+# C260 finite hinge-declaration observation contract
+
+**Version: 0.1.0.** Contract identifier:
+`ontokin.c260.hinge-declarations/0.1`.
+This document specifies a later read-only observation component. C260 itself
+contains no implementation. Independent review and publication receipts are
+separate from the contract's behavioral requirements.
+
+## 1. Purpose and governing meaning
+
+Observe the **declared** hinge kind, ordered site endpoints, axis, closed limits
+and initial coordinate for the frozen C253 public keyed-rack family. Derive
+these facts from actual supplied `.ok` bytes and separately read the actual GLB
+joint rows. A successful comparison establishes agreement of these fields and
+their source/object associations only.
+
+The adopted [core specification](../../language-design/OK-LANG-001-core-language-specification.md)
+sections 5.3, 6.1 and 7.2–7.4 govern units, identity, sites and joints. The
+[construction specification](../../language-design/OK-LANG-002-pinned-modules-and-keyed-assembly-construction.md)
+governs pinned modules, keyed occurrences and GLB/0.2 source associations.
+[OK-ENG-002](../OK-ENG-002-3d-scene-animation-export-and-visual-validation.md)
+section 5 distinguishes preserved relationship metadata from baked motion.
+The [C210 transport contract](../semantic-export-c210/CONTRACT.md) does not make
+its producer sidecar an independent source of hinge truth.
+
+This is a deliberately smaller observation profile than the language. Refusing
+a valid but unsupported expression means **not observed under this profile**;
+it does not redefine that expression as invalid OntoKin. No language or exporter
+semantics, C253/C255 formulas, or prior tolerance is changed.
+
+## 2. Four distinct authority boundaries
+
+These names describe the required future interfaces; they are not callable
+APIs delivered by C260.
+
+| Interface | Permitted result |
+| --- | --- |
+| `observe_source_hinges(source_files)` | Source-derived hinge occurrences and definitions, ordered endpoint site associations, literal values and exact byte witnesses. No artifact agreement or historical admission. |
+| `observe_glb_hinges(raw)` | Untrusted joint rows, object/source-map claims and actual JSON pointers. No independent source truth or accepted-revision claim. |
+| `compare_hinges(source_files, raw)` | Complete set agreement for supported hinge fields after source/program/object association. Source-derived site records remain distinct from artifact path claims. |
+| `read_bound_endpoint(repo, endpoint)` | The same comparison after exact original source and GLB size/hash admission for `before` or `after`. |
+
+The first three interfaces must permit supported changed inputs. They must not
+hardcode the original eight joints, names, values or original hashes. Changed
+dependency bytes require an updated exact import digest and corresponding
+program/source claims. Only the fourth interface labels the original historical
+inputs as admitted. No interface grants execution or release authority.
+
+The exact [input bindings](INPUTS.json) identify the existing C257 lexical,
+module and bounded occurrence utilities that may be reused read-only. Their
+ownership results cannot supply a hinge, site endpoint, axis, limit or initial
+value. Reuse must preserve their exact input binding and refusal behavior;
+additional source joint/site and artifact association checks belong to the new
+component. Calling an ownership/follow comparator is not independent hinge
+derivation. Product parsers/evaluators/exporters, C255 expected records, producer
+sidecars and sampled poses must not supply expected hinge fields.
+
+## 3. Supported source declarations and associations
+
+### 3.1 Module and occurrence context
+
+Admit exactly the supplied entry `main.ok` and pinned leaf
+`example.hinges@1.0.0` source `hinges.ok`, both `construction-0.1`. Resolve classes
+through the actual import alias and declaring module. Definitions with omitted
+module visibility follow the adopted public default. Private imported classes
+are inaccessible; a private ordinary part inside its defining class remains
+accessible there.
+
+Use the C257 bounded occurrence subset: scene root objects, ordinary parts, and
+keyed generated parts over a direct owner keyed parameter. Membership comes
+from a direct typed keyed literal or a helper that directly returns one, using
+the final direct owner override before the class default. Each observed keyed
+input must contain 1–64 keys, retaining C257's nonempty finite subset. An empty
+typed keyed value is language-valid but unsupported here. Keys and occurrence
+containment determine identity; generator order does not. Numeric keyed values
+and helper arguments do not supply hinge fields. Nested/per-key overrides of
+membership are unsupported and refuse. Other original length overrides remain
+unobserved because this profile does not evaluate endpoint poses or geometry.
+
+Reject duplicate relevant names/keys, reserved implicit-member collisions and
+shadowing of predefined names used by this resolver. In particular, authored
+members cannot substitute for `self`, `frame` or `origin`, or turn the observed
+`vec3`/`range` constructors into user calls. An ambiguous source is never
+resolved by declaration order or fixture similarity.
+
+### 3.2 Hinge declaration
+
+Every joint in an instantiated class must be an explicitly public or private
+`joint NAME @ "KEY": hinge` declaration with exactly one assignment each for
+`parent`, `child`, `axis`, `limits` and `initial`. There are no optional defaults
+for these five fields. Duplicate/missing/extra fields refuse. Scene-level
+joints, another joint kind, inheritance, relation overrides and joint syntax in
+an unsupported position refuse. Uninstantiated definitions are not qualified;
+the observer is not a complete source-validity checker.
+
+The hinge occurrence ID is its owning object occurrence ID followed by its
+literal member key. Its definition ID is the owning class definition ID followed
+by that key. These namespaces are distinct. A reused class produces separate
+hinge occurrences that share a definition. Record the literal name/key,
+defining source/hash/span, owning occurrence/class, generation witnesses and
+the actual source expressions for all five fields.
+
+### 3.3 Ordered site endpoints
+
+Support `self.SITE` and `self.PART.SITE`, where `PART` is one directly declared
+ordinary part and the terminal name denotes an explicitly declared site.
+Resolve each token in its actual lexical class and module. A private current
+class part can be traversed by that class; a terminal site on another class
+must be public. A site on `self` may be private. Reject arbitrary object
+references, keyed traversal inside the endpoint expression, deeper chains,
+aliases/parameters/computed `SiteRef` values and implicit `origin` endpoints in
+this finite subset. The language may support some of these separately.
+
+Retain the parent/child order. The endpoints must belong to two distinct object
+occurrences. A site occurrence ID is its actual owning object ID followed by
+the site's literal key; its definition ID extends its defining class ID.
+Part names, site names and stable keys are separately resolved. A dotted
+display path, a shared suffix or the joint's owning object alone is insufficient
+to identify a site. Legal keys containing dots, underscores or hyphens remain
+opaque literal keys.
+
+Endpoint sites must have the three declared assignments `pose`, `interface`
+and `size` exactly once. For the limited source compatibility check, `interface`
+is a nonempty literal string and `size` is a nonnegative literal Length in m,
+cm or mm. Require exact equality of both endpoints' interface strings and
+canonical sizes. Record these as **source-only** compatibility facts. Computed
+or parameterized interface/size forms refuse. The `pose` expression is retained
+as a byte witness but is not evaluated. Its frame, orientation, offset and
+time independence remain unqualified by this component, including the existing
+`-self.length / 2` child-site offset.
+
+## 4. Literal values and numerical policy
+
+### 4.1 Axis subset
+
+`axis` must be `vec3` of three signed dimensionless numeric literals. After
+canonical binary64 conversion, admit exactly one component equal to +1 or -1
+and the other two equal to zero. This covers the six signed coordinate basis
+axes and both original endpoints. Parent-site axes provide the reference frame;
+no world-axis value is inferred.
+
+Every admitted axis has norm exactly one, so the language's normalization is
+the identity operation. **Do not canonicalize axis sign.** Reversing an axis
+without transforming the coordinate convention changes the declared field.
+Zero, nonunit and nonbasis vectors refuse; a normalized nonbasis vector may
+be valid in OntoKin but is outside this observer. General normalization and
+its rounding policy require a later version, not an implicit extension.
+
+### 4.2 Angles and site sizes
+
+`limits` must be `range(LOW, HIGH)` and `initial` one signed Angle literal. Only
+`deg` and `rad` suffixes are supported. Parameters, even typed Angle parameters,
+references, arithmetic, calls other than the named constructors, conditionals
+and computed bounds refuse. The baseline contains only these literals, so no
+parameter dependency is silently substituted by its original value.
+
+Combine the exact decimal literal with the exact unit factor and round once
+to canonical binary64, ties to even. `rad` has factor one; `deg` has factor
+`Pi64/180`, with `Pi64` the exact binary64 value
+`0x1.921fb54442d18p+1`. Use the represented binary64 Pi64, not mathematical pi
+or a library approximation. Length factors are exactly 1, 1/100 and 1/1000 for
+m, cm and mm. Apply unary sign without another arithmetic rounding. All
+canonical values must be finite. Positive and negative zero compare equally.
+
+Require `LOW <= HIGH` and `LOW <= initial <= HIGH` on the canonical values.
+Boundaries are inclusive and a zero-width range is admitted. No epsilon widens
+a limit. Original ±45 degrees become ±`0x1.921fb54442d18p-1` radians, and the
+initial 0 radians is exactly zero.
+
+Source/artifact comparison uses **exact canonical numeric equality** for this
+literal/basis subset. Artifact JSON numbers represent canonical radians for
+limits/initial and dimensionless axis components. JSON integers and floats may
+represent numbers; booleans, strings, nonfinite values and wrong shapes refuse.
+Do not normalize, round again, change sign, sort limits or clamp an artifact
+value. This policy introduces no tolerance for general computed hinges and
+makes no exporter-wide error guarantee. The C258 quaternion allowance is
+unrelated and must not be borrowed for axes or angles.
+
+## 5. Actual artifact fields and comparison
+
+Read the exact GLB JSON chunk under `ontokin.glb/0.2`, schema `0.2` and profile
+`construction-0.1`. Each `/extras/ontokin/joints/i` row has exactly `path`,
+`element_id`, `kind`, `parent_site`, `child_site`, `axis`, `limits` and `initial`.
+`kind` must be `hinge`; axis is a three-number tuple, limits a two-number tuple
+and initial a number. In the raw artifact interface, these remain claims.
+
+Before comparison, bind actual source hashes/imports and the canonical program
+manifest/revision to `/extras/ontokin/source`, `/extras/ontokin/program`, the
+complete object occurrence table and each corresponding object node's
+`source_mapping`, `class_name`, `element_id`, `path` and `program_revision`.
+Repeated source, class, key, revision and byte-span claims must agree. Source
+byte bounds are integers, never booleans or fractional numbers, and must match
+the actual declarations. Node order and joint-row order do not define identity.
+
+Associate each joint through the complete source-derived owning object and
+class mapping, its full occurrence ID and its independently rendered path.
+Require an exact one-to-one set: no missing, extra or duplicated joint IDs or
+paths. The owning object must exist exactly once in the full object mapping.
+Associate each artifact endpoint path with one complete source-derived site
+path on its independently mapped owning object. Do not split a path on dots
+or discard quoted key boundaries. Compare endpoint order and all numerical
+fields without fitting to motion samples.
+
+The actual artifacts have **no direct site table, joint definition ID, joint
+source span, site definition ID or site source span**. An artifact endpoint is
+a path claim, not an embedded site definition. Source-based associations must
+be labeled derived; the absent artifact fields must remain absent. The axis
+frame is the parent-site convention, not a separately encoded frame field.
+Endpoint site poses, interface/size copies and joint-coordinate evolution are
+not directly observed from this GLB. No source-derived value may be presented
+as a direct artifact measurement.
+
+## 6. Bounds and refusal behavior
+
+Preserve the inherited two-file closure, 65,536 bytes/8,192 tokens per source,
+32 nesting levels, 32 definitions per module, 128 objects and 1–64 unique keys
+per literal keyed input. Add at most 128 hinge rows and 256 distinct referenced
+sites. Authored declaration and keyed-input keys must satisfy the adopted ASCII
+grammar `[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}`; reject invalid or longer keys before
+identity expansion. This validation is required in addition to inherited
+generic string checks. Other consumed nonempty text and serialized identity
+components have a resource cap of 512 Unicode scalar values without control or
+surrogate characters; that cap does not enlarge the authored stable-key domain.
+Identity arrays have at most 32 components. Recursive containment, duplicate
+identities and ambiguous bindings refuse.
+
+Admit at most 4 MiB GLB with exactly one JSON chunk of at most 2 MiB followed
+by one BIN chunk, aligned lengths and an exact GLB 2 header. Reject duplicate
+JSON keys. Before numeric allocation/conversion, bound each numeric lexeme to
+64 characters and its explicit exponent to [-400, 400]. Nonzero values after
+the selected unit factor must have adjusted decimal exponent in [-324, 308];
+zero still obeys the explicit-exponent bound. Nonfinite canonical results
+refuse. These limits apply to all numerical fields consumed by this profile.
+
+Raw interfaces consume supplied `bytes` only. The historical file interface
+checks expected size before bounded reads and SHA-256, rejects symbolic-link
+files/ancestors, and refuses paths outside the supplied repository. Missing
+files, symlink loops, permission errors, malformed UTF-8/JSON/GLB, recursion,
+overflow and unsupported source forms become explicit typed refusals. No
+network lookup, ambient module, fallback parser, partial success or silently
+omitted row can complete a failed observation.
+
+Refusal categories must distinguish malformed/contradictory input, supported
+field disagreement, historical byte mismatch, resource limit, unsupported
+source form and I/O failure. They are observer outcomes, not substituted
+OntoKin compiler diagnostics. A failed comparison retains its input identities
+and reason without emitting a qualified hinge set.
+
+## 7. Required qualification and nonclaims
+
+The [control plan](CONTROL-PLAN.md) is mandatory for a later implementation and
+remains unrun in C260. Independent review must derive expected values without
+the observer, vary source and metadata separately, include supported paired
+changes and distinguish missing direct provenance from source associations.
+Retain every failed attempt and exact checked source/input hashes.
+
+A successful finite result does not validate site poses, endpoint world
+alignment, combined follow/joint pose authority, physical modes, joint cycles,
+action admission or motion. It does not imply complete source/glTF validity,
+complete C255 semantic records, accepted revisions, invalid-edit atomicity,
+clean rebuild equivalence, native behavior, model-trial success or comparative
+advantage. Unrelated metadata may remain unobserved; no pass endorses it.
+
+After contract review, applicable documentation checks and integration, create
+and verify one saved handoff and stop. Implementing this contract is the next
+separate bounded scope. Further source-expression support needs an explicit
+versioned amendment and new independent controls before it is claimed.

+
+**Status: planned, unrun.** C260 delivers this plan and a fixed-input design
+inspection. There is no hinge observer to execute these cases against yet.
+These controls become required for the later implementation; no case below
+is a current passing result.
+
+## Independence and input construction
+
+The reviewer must author expected field values and source associations from
+the adopted rules and actual source bytes, without importing the new observer,
+product compiler/evaluator/exporter, C255 oracle, producer semantic sidecar or
+motion output. A small independent JSON/GLB fixture editor may change copied
+metadata, preserving chunk alignment and size. It must not obtain its expected
+hinge answers from the implementation being reviewed.
+
+When source bytes change, update their exact import pin and canonical
+program/source provenance in any deliberately paired artifact. Distinguish a
+binding refusal from a field mismatch: for a source-only numerical control,
+update necessary provenance claims while deliberately retaining the old hinge
+field. That isolates the field comparison. Also keep a stale-provenance case
+to verify binding refusal itself. A claimed successful paired change must
+change actual source and actual metadata, not only an expected-answer table.
+
+Use separate outputs for raw source observation, raw artifact observation,
+comparison and historical byte admission. Record every input hash, exact
+checked implementation revision, commands, outcomes and original failures.
+Run no source evaluator, export, native application or model trial.

+# C260 field origins and association limits
+
+The [contract](CONTRACT.md) observes declaration metadata. Source values and
+artifact claims are separate inputs. Every future source observation must
+retain the actual filename, SHA-256 and integer UTF-8 byte interval
+`[startByte, endByteExclusive)`. Every artifact claim must retain the actual
+artifact SHA-256 and JSON pointer. Association does not turn an absent direct
+artifact field into an observation.
+
+## Field mapping
+
+| Field | Independent source origin | Actual GLB origin and limit |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Hinge occurrence ID | Owning root/ordinary/generated occurrence keys plus the joint's literal member key | `/extras/ontokin/joints/i/element_id`; compared as a complete array |
+| Hinge display path | Actual lexical occurrence/member names and correctly quoted keyed steps | `/extras/ontokin/joints/i/path`; not sufficient without full identity/class association |
+| Hinge definition ID | Owning class definition identity plus joint key | No direct field; source-derived association through the mapped owning object/class and joint key |
+| Hinge declaration span | Full actual `joint ... : hinge { ... }` byte span | Absent; object spans cannot be relabeled joint spans |
+| Hinge kind | Actual declaration type token `hinge` | `/extras/ontokin/joints/i/kind` |
+| Parent endpoint | Actual `parent` expression, lexical member/part/site lookup, terminal site key and defining class | `/extras/ontokin/joints/i/parent_site`, a path claim only |
+| Child endpoint | Actual `child` expression and its separate lexical part/site lookup | `/extras/ontokin/joints/i/child_site`, a path claim only; do not reorder endpoints |
+| Endpoint owning object IDs | The source occurrences on which the resolved sites are declared | Object node `path`, `element_id`, `class_name`, `source_mapping` and corresponding program occurrence claims |
+| Endpoint site occurrence IDs | Actual endpoint object ID plus the terminal site's literal key | Absent as direct site IDs; associate the actual endpoint path with the independently derived site map |
+| Endpoint site definition IDs/spans | Declaring source class identity, site key and site declaration bytes | Absent; no site table exists in either bound artifact |
+| Endpoint interface/size | Literal site `interface` and `size`, checked for equal interface and canonical nonnegative size | Absent; retain as source-only compatibility facts |
+| Endpoint site pose | The source `pose` assignment byte witness only | No direct site-pose field; value/frame/orientation are unobserved in this profile |
+| Axis components | Three literal numeric tokens in the actual `vec3` expression, admitted signed-basis subset | `/extras/ontokin/joints/i/axis`; preserve sign and compare exact canonical components |
+| Axis reference frame | Adopted hinge convention: the resolved **parent site's** axes | No separate axis-frame field; it is not inferred from node/world rotation |
+| Lower and upper limits | The two ordered actual Angle literals in `range`, their signs and deg/rad factors | `/extras/ontokin/joints/i/limits/0` and `/1`, canonical radians |
+| Initial coordinate | The actual initial Angle literal and unit factor | `/extras/ontokin/joints/i/initial`, canonical radians; not an animation sample |
+| Source/program identity | Actual bytes, exact import digest and independently constructed canonical bundle manifest/revision | `/extras/ontokin/source`, `/extras/ontokin/program` and all repeated node/source-map claims |
+
+Ownership, following, scene-root indices, node transforms, animation channels,
+producer sidecars and C255 expected records are not origins for any hinge
+value. Occurrence containment is used to identify where a declaration is
+instantiated; it does not create a mechanical relationship by itself.
+
+## Concrete frozen association
+
+The source defines one `Finger.flex` hinge member and instantiates it three
+times under `first` and five times under `second`. The same definition is
+therefore associated with eight distinct hinge occurrences. The selected
+middle finger's length edit changes neither this member nor its literal
+hinge fields.
+
+| Concept | Original first middle finger |
+| --- | --- |
+| Owning object occurrence | `["keyed-rack","demo","first","fingers","middle"]` |
+| Joint occurrence | `["keyed-rack","demo","first","fingers","middle","flex"]` |
+| Joint definition | `["package","example.hinges","hinges","definitions","finger","flex"]` |
+| Parent site occurrence | `["keyed-rack","demo","first","fingers","middle","pivot"]` |
+| Parent site definition | `["package","example.hinges","hinges","definitions","finger","pivot"]` |
+| Child site occurrence | `["keyed-rack","demo","first","fingers","middle","blade","base"]` |
+| Child site definition | `["package","example.hinges","hinges","definitions","blade","base"]` |
+| Actual artifact row | `/extras/ontokin/joints/1` in each original artifact |
+| Parent/child path claims | `first.fingers["middle"].pivot` and `first.fingers["middle"].blade.base` |
+| Axis/limits/initial | `[0,0,1]` in parent-site axes; `[-0.7853981633974483,0.7853981633974483]` radians; `0` radians |
+
+The row index is an observed location, not an identity rule. Reordering rows
+changes pointers while retaining identities. All sixteen endpoint site
+occurrences are source-associated; none is an embedded GLB site record.
+
+[BASELINE-INSPECTION.json](BASELINE-INSPECTION.json) retains the actual source
+witnesses, the manually derived eight occurrence/definition associations and
+every actual joint row from each bound GLB. Its fixed-input inspection is
+evidence for designing the contract. A future implementation must derive
+changed source values independently instead of loading this baseline as an
+answer table.

+# C260: finite hinge-declaration observation contract
+
+C260 defines what a later independent reader may say about the existing
+keyed-rack hinges. A hinge joins two named attachment sites and declares an
+axis, angular limits and an initial angle. Those declarations are separate
+from object ownership, spatial following and recorded motion.
+
+This increment contains a **contract and input inspection only**. It adds no
+hinge reader and establishes no hinge implementation qualification. It follows
+the [C258 integrated next task](../localized-repair-c258/INTEGRATED-NEXT-TASK.md)
+under [scope #247](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/issues/247).
+
+## Selected boundary
+
+The future reader will derive class-member hinge declarations from the two
+supplied `.ok` files and compare the corresponding rows in the actual GLB JSON.
+The supported subset uses literal signed coordinate axes and literal angular
+limits/initial values. It resolves ordered endpoint references to declared
+sites on the current object or a direct ordinary part. It retains complete
+occurrence, definition and source-byte associations.
+
+The existing artifacts contain eight joint rows at each endpoint. They contain
+no site table, joint-definition table or joint/site source-span records.
+Therefore site identity and definition associations come from the supplied
+source; site poses and the resulting world motion remain unobserved here.
+No missing artifact field is filled with a producer sidecar or an expected
+semantic record.
+
+## Read in order
+
+1. [Version 0.1.0 contract](CONTRACT.md): authority, supported forms, comparison
+   policy, refusals and implementation gate.
+2. [Field origins](FIELD-ORIGINS.md): source witnesses, actual JSON pointers and
+   unavailable artifact provenance.
+3. [Input bindings](INPUTS.json) and [baseline inspection](BASELINE-INSPECTION.json):
+   exact hashes, 37 source witnesses, eight source-derived joint associations
+   and the 16 actual rows across the two artifacts.
+4. [Independent control plan](CONTROL-PLAN.md): required future checks; these
+   are planned cases, not passed implementation tests.
+5. [Next bounded task](NEXT-TASK.md): implement and independently check this
+   finite reader after the reviewed contract is integrated and handed off.
+
+## Evidence and limitations
+
+The inspected baseline is published main
+`003b3a7827486405c3d00f039c1c9746c9be75fc`, tree
+`325c7e50b42000e7c2976e3dd8c3babcec2649ba`. The inspection checked twelve source,
+specification and artifact bindings and read the actual GLB JSON bytes without
+importing the product parser, evaluator, exporter or C255 expected records.
+It confirms that the proposed subset covers both frozen endpoints. It does
+not exercise the future control plan.
+
+The [C253 protocol](../localized-repair-c253/README.md), earlier component
+implementations, all numerical tolerances and prior failures retain their
+existing meanings. Complete semantic records, site-frame transport, motion
+agreement, revision authenticity, invalid-edit atomicity, clean rebuilds,
+native/model trials and comparative advantage remain separate unmet gates.
+
+Applicable integration checks are independent contract review, exact binding
+verification, the unchanged C253 manifest check and the repository documentation
+preservation/link check. The integrator records their actual revision and
+outcome separately. A specification review cannot substitute for a future
+implementation check.

+
+C260 defines a finite hinge-declaration observation profile. It contains no
+hinge reader, no product evaluation and no native or model trial. The 28
+implementation control groups are **UNRUN**.
+
+## Exact scientific and input scope
+
+The seven authored files were frozen in local commit

+file. The inspected baseline is published main
+`003b3a7827486405c3d00f039c1c9746c9be75fc`; its 12 bound inputs remain exact.
+
+The profile derives joint occurrence/definition identities, ordered site
+endpoints, six signed coordinate axes and literal rad/deg limits and initial
+angles. Conversion uses the adopted exact Pi64/180 factor and one binary64
+rounding; comparison is exact for this subset. No general normalization or
+computed-angle evaluator is implied.
+

+inspection covers 37 source byte witnesses and 16 actual rows across two GLBs.

+separate from directly read artifact claims. Site interface/size compatibility
+is source-only; site poses, world alignment and complete joint validity are

+
+## Independent review and preserved corrections
+
+The [review record](evidence/review/REVIEW.md) binds the corrected seven-file
+contract and exact input evidence. Its fixed-input assertions and source-map
+span checks inspect real bytes and declarations; they are not implementation
+controls. Two original ambiguities were corrected: stable keys retain their
+adopted ASCII domain and 64-character limit, and reused C257 keyed membership
+is explicitly nonempty. The [complete first draft](evidence/author/attempt01/)

+# C260 finite hinge-declaration observation contract
+
+**Version: 0.1.0.** Contract identifier:
+`ontokin.c260.hinge-declarations/0.1`.
+This document specifies a later read-only observation component. C260 itself
+contains no implementation. Independent review and publication receipts are
+separate from the contract's behavioral requirements.
+
+## 1. Purpose and governing meaning
+
+Observe the **declared** hinge kind, ordered site endpoints, axis, closed limits
+and initial coordinate for the frozen C253 public keyed-rack family. Derive
+these facts from actual supplied `.ok` bytes and separately read the actual GLB
+joint rows. A successful comparison establishes agreement of these fields and
+their source/object associations only.
+
+The adopted [core specification](../../language-design/OK-LANG-001-core-language-specification.md)
+sections 5.3, 6.1 and 7.2–7.4 govern units, identity, sites and joints. The
+[construction specification](../../language-design/OK-LANG-002-pinned-modules-and-keyed-assembly-construction.md)
+governs pinned modules, keyed occurrences and GLB/0.2 source associations.
+[OK-ENG-002](../OK-ENG-002-3d-scene-animation-export-and-visual-validation.md)
+section 5 distinguishes preserved relationship metadata from baked motion.
+The [C210 transport contract](../semantic-export-c210/CONTRACT.md) does not make
+its producer sidecar an independent source of hinge truth.
+
+This is a deliberately smaller observation profile than the language. Refusing
+a valid but unsupported expression means **not observed under this profile**;
+it does not redefine that expression as invalid OntoKin. No language or exporter
+semantics, C253/C255 formulas, or prior tolerance is changed.
+
+## 2. Four distinct authority boundaries
+
+These names describe the required future interfaces; they are not callable
+APIs delivered by C260.
+
+| Interface | Permitted result |
+| --- | --- |
+| `observe_source_hinges(source_files)` | Source-derived hinge occurrences and definitions, ordered endpoint site associations, literal values and exact byte witnesses. No artifact agreement or historical admission. |
+| `observe_glb_hinges(raw)` | Untrusted joint rows, object/source-map claims and actual JSON pointers. No independent source truth or accepted-revision claim. |
+| `compare_hinges(source_files, raw)` | Complete set agreement for supported hinge fields after source/program/object association. Source-derived site records remain distinct from artifact path claims. |
+| `read_bound_endpoint(repo, endpoint)` | The same comparison after exact original source and GLB size/hash admission for `before` or `after`. |
+
+The first three interfaces must permit supported changed inputs. They must not
+hardcode the original eight joints, names, values or original hashes. Changed
+dependency bytes require an updated exact import digest and corresponding
+program/source claims. Only the fourth interface labels the original historical
+inputs as admitted. No interface grants execution or release authority.
+
+The exact [input bindings](INPUTS.json) identify the existing C257 lexical,
+module and bounded occurrence utilities that may be reused read-only. Their
+ownership results cannot supply a hinge, site endpoint, axis, limit or initial
+value. Reuse must preserve their exact input binding and refusal behavior;
+additional source joint/site and artifact association checks belong to the new
+component. Calling an ownership/follow comparator is not independent hinge
+derivation. Product parsers/evaluators/exporters, C255 expected records, producer
+sidecars and sampled poses must not supply expected hinge fields.
+
+## 3. Supported source declarations and associations
+
+### 3.1 Module and occurrence context
+
+Admit exactly the supplied entry `main.ok` and pinned leaf
+`example.hinges@1.0.0` source `hinges.ok`, both `construction-0.1`. Resolve classes
+through the actual import alias and declaring module. Definitions with omitted
+module visibility follow the adopted public default. Private imported classes
+are inaccessible; a private ordinary part inside its defining class remains
+accessible there.
+
+Use the C257 bounded occurrence subset: scene root objects, ordinary parts, and
+keyed generated parts over a direct owner keyed parameter. Membership comes
+from a direct typed keyed literal or a helper that directly returns one, using
+the final direct owner override before the class default. Keys and occurrence
+containment determine identity; generator order does not. Numeric keyed values
+and helper arguments do not supply hinge fields. Nested/per-key overrides of
+membership are unsupported and refuse. Other original length overrides remain
+unobserved because this profile does not evaluate endpoint poses or geometry.
+
+Reject duplicate relevant names/keys, reserved implicit-member collisions and
+shadowing of predefined names used by this resolver. In particular, authored
+members cannot substitute for `self`, `frame` or `origin`, or turn the observed
+`vec3`/`range` constructors into user calls. An ambiguous source is never
+resolved by declaration order or fixture similarity.
+
+### 3.2 Hinge declaration
+
+Every joint in an instantiated class must be an explicitly public or private
+`joint NAME @ "KEY": hinge` declaration with exactly one assignment each for
+`parent`, `child`, `axis`, `limits` and `initial`. There are no optional defaults
+for these five fields. Duplicate/missing/extra fields refuse. Scene-level
+joints, another joint kind, inheritance, relation overrides and joint syntax in
+an unsupported position refuse. Uninstantiated definitions are not qualified;
+the observer is not a complete source-validity checker.
+
+The hinge occurrence ID is its owning object occurrence ID followed by its
+literal member key. Its definition ID is the owning class definition ID followed
+by that key. These namespaces are distinct. A reused class produces separate
+hinge occurrences that share a definition. Record the literal name/key,
+defining source/hash/span, owning occurrence/class, generation witnesses and
+the actual source expressions for all five fields.
+
+### 3.3 Ordered site endpoints
+
+Support `self.SITE` and `self.PART.SITE`, where `PART` is one directly declared
+ordinary part and the terminal name denotes an explicitly declared site.
+Resolve each token in its actual lexical class and module. A private current
+class part can be traversed by that class; a terminal site on another class
+must be public. A site on `self` may be private. Reject arbitrary object
+references, keyed traversal inside the endpoint expression, deeper chains,
+aliases/parameters/computed `SiteRef` values and implicit `origin` endpoints in
+this finite subset. The language may support some of these separately.
+
+Retain the parent/child order. The endpoints must belong to two distinct object
+occurrences. A site occurrence ID is its actual owning object ID followed by
+the site's literal key; its definition ID extends its defining class ID.
+Part names, site names and stable keys are separately resolved. A dotted
+display path, a shared suffix or the joint's owning object alone is insufficient
+to identify a site. Keys containing punctuation remain opaque literal keys.
+
+Endpoint sites must have the three declared assignments `pose`, `interface`
+and `size` exactly once. For the limited source compatibility check, `interface`
+is a nonempty literal string and `size` is a nonnegative literal Length in m,
+cm or mm. Require exact equality of both endpoints' interface strings and
+canonical sizes. Record these as **source-only** compatibility facts. Computed
+or parameterized interface/size forms refuse. The `pose` expression is retained
+as a byte witness but is not evaluated. Its frame, orientation, offset and
+time independence remain unqualified by this component, including the existing
+`-self.length / 2` child-site offset.
+
+## 4. Literal values and numerical policy
+
+### 4.1 Axis subset
+
+`axis` must be `vec3` of three signed dimensionless numeric literals. After
+canonical binary64 conversion, admit exactly one component equal to +1 or -1
+and the other two equal to zero. This covers the six signed coordinate basis
+axes and both original endpoints. Parent-site axes provide the reference frame;
+no world-axis value is inferred.
+
+Every admitted axis has norm exactly one, so the language's normalization is
+the identity operation. **Do not canonicalize axis sign.** Reversing an axis
+without transforming the coordinate convention changes the declared field.
+Zero, nonunit and nonbasis vectors refuse; a normalized nonbasis vector may
+be valid in OntoKin but is outside this observer. General normalization and
+its rounding policy require a later version, not an implicit extension.
+
+### 4.2 Angles and site sizes
+
+`limits` must be `range(LOW, HIGH)` and `initial` one signed Angle literal. Only
+`deg` and `rad` suffixes are supported. Parameters, even typed Angle parameters,
+references, arithmetic, calls other than the named constructors, conditionals
+and computed bounds refuse. The baseline contains only these literals, so no
+parameter dependency is silently substituted by its original value.
+
+Combine the exact decimal literal with the exact unit factor and round once
+to canonical binary64, ties to even. `rad` has factor one; `deg` has factor
+`Pi64/180`, with `Pi64` the exact binary64 value
+`0x1.921fb54442d18p+1`. Use the represented binary64 Pi64, not mathematical pi
+or a library approximation. Length factors are exactly 1, 1/100 and 1/1000 for
+m, cm and mm. Apply unary sign without another arithmetic rounding. All
+canonical values must be finite. Positive and negative zero compare equally.
+
+Require `LOW <= HIGH` and `LOW <= initial <= HIGH` on the canonical values.
+Boundaries are inclusive and a zero-width range is admitted. No epsilon widens
+a limit. Original ±45 degrees become ±`0x1.921fb54442d18p-1` radians, and the
+initial 0 radians is exactly zero.
+
+Source/artifact comparison uses **exact canonical numeric equality** for this
+literal/basis subset. Artifact JSON numbers represent canonical radians for
+limits/initial and dimensionless axis components. JSON integers and floats may
+represent numbers; booleans, strings, nonfinite values and wrong shapes refuse.
+Do not normalize, round again, change sign, sort limits or clamp an artifact
+value. This policy introduces no tolerance for general computed hinges and
+makes no exporter-wide error guarantee. The C258 quaternion allowance is
+unrelated and must not be borrowed for axes or angles.
+
+## 5. Actual artifact fields and comparison
+
+Read the exact GLB JSON chunk under `ontokin.glb/0.2`, schema `0.2` and profile
+`construction-0.1`. Each `/extras/ontokin/joints/i` row has exactly `path`,
+`element_id`, `kind`, `parent_site`, `child_site`, `axis`, `limits` and `initial`.
+`kind` must be `hinge`; axis is a three-number tuple, limits a two-number tuple
+and initial a number. In the raw artifact interface, these remain claims.
+
+Before comparison, bind actual source hashes/imports and the canonical program
+manifest/revision to `/extras/ontokin/source`, `/extras/ontokin/program`, the
+complete object occurrence table and each corresponding object node's
+`source_mapping`, `class_name`, `element_id`, `path` and `program_revision`.
+Repeated source, class, key, revision and byte-span claims must agree. Source
+byte bounds are integers, never booleans or fractional numbers, and must match
+the actual declarations. Node order and joint-row order do not define identity.
+
+Associate each joint through the complete source-derived owning object and
+class mapping, its full occurrence ID and its independently rendered path.
+Require an exact one-to-one set: no missing, extra or duplicated joint IDs or
+paths. The owning object must exist exactly once in the full object mapping.
+Associate each artifact endpoint path with one complete source-derived site
+path on its independently mapped owning object. Do not split a path on dots
+or discard quoted key boundaries. Compare endpoint order and all numerical
+fields without fitting to motion samples.
+
+The actual artifacts have **no direct site table, joint definition ID, joint
+source span, site definition ID or site source span**. An artifact endpoint is
+a path claim, not an embedded site definition. Source-based associations must
+be labeled derived; the absent artifact fields must remain absent. The axis
+frame is the parent-site convention, not a separately encoded frame field.
+Endpoint site poses, interface/size copies and joint-coordinate evolution are
+not directly observed from this GLB. No source-derived value may be presented
+as a direct artifact measurement.
+
+## 6. Bounds and refusal behavior
+
+Preserve the inherited two-file closure, 65,536 bytes/8,192 tokens per source,
+32 nesting levels, 32 definitions per module, 128 objects and 64 unique keys
+per literal keyed input. Add at most 128 hinge rows and 256 distinct referenced
+sites. Text/key components are nonempty, at most 512 Unicode scalar values,
+without control or surrogate characters. Identity arrays have at most 32
+components. Recursive containment, duplicate identities and ambiguous bindings
+refuse.
+
+Admit at most 4 MiB GLB with exactly one JSON chunk of at most 2 MiB followed
+by one BIN chunk, aligned lengths and an exact GLB 2 header. Reject duplicate
+JSON keys. Before numeric allocation/conversion, bound each numeric lexeme to
+64 characters and its explicit exponent to [-400, 400]. Nonzero values after
+the selected unit factor must have adjusted decimal exponent in [-324, 308];
+zero still obeys the explicit-exponent bound. Nonfinite canonical results
+refuse. These limits apply to all numerical fields consumed by this profile.
+
+Raw interfaces consume supplied `bytes` only. The historical file interface
+checks expected size before bounded reads and SHA-256, rejects symbolic-link
+files/ancestors, and refuses paths outside the supplied repository. Missing
+files, symlink loops, permission errors, malformed UTF-8/JSON/GLB, recursion,
+overflow and unsupported source forms become explicit typed refusals. No
+network lookup, ambient module, fallback parser, partial success or silently
+omitted row can complete a failed observation.
+
+Refusal categories must distinguish malformed/contradictory input, supported
+field disagreement, historical byte mismatch, resource limit, unsupported
+source form and I/O failure. They are observer outcomes, not substituted
+OntoKin compiler diagnostics. A failed comparison retains its input identities
+and reason without emitting a qualified hinge set.
+
+## 7. Required qualification and nonclaims
+
+The [control plan](CONTROL-PLAN.md) is mandatory for a later implementation and
+remains unrun in C260. Independent review must derive expected values without
+the observer, vary source and metadata separately, include supported paired
+changes and distinguish missing direct provenance from source associations.
+Retain every failed attempt and exact checked source/input hashes.
+
+A successful finite result does not validate site poses, endpoint world
+alignment, combined follow/joint pose authority, physical modes, joint cycles,
+action admission or motion. It does not imply complete source/glTF validity,
+complete C255 semantic records, accepted revisions, invalid-edit atomicity,
+clean rebuild equivalence, native behavior, model-trial success or comparative
+advantage. Unrelated metadata may remain unobserved; no pass endorses it.
+
+After contract review, applicable documentation checks and integration, create
+and verify one saved handoff and stop. Implementing this contract is the next
+separate bounded scope. Further source-expression support needs an explicit
+versioned amendment and new independent controls before it is claimed.

+
+**Status: planned, unrun.** C260 delivers this plan and a fixed-input design

+
+## Independence and input construction
+
+The reviewer must author expected field values and source associations from
+the adopted rules and actual source bytes, without importing the new observer,
+product compiler/evaluator/exporter, C255 oracle, producer semantic sidecar or
+motion output. A small independent JSON/GLB fixture editor may change copied
+metadata, preserving chunk alignment and size. It must not obtain its expected
+hinge answers from the implementation being reviewed.
+
+When source bytes change, update their exact import pin and canonical
+program/source provenance in any deliberately paired artifact. Distinguish a
+binding refusal from a field mismatch: for a source-only numerical control,
+update necessary provenance claims while deliberately retaining the old hinge
+field. That isolates the field comparison. Also keep a stale-provenance case
+to verify binding refusal itself. A claimed successful paired change must
+change actual source and actual metadata, not only an expected-answer table.
+
+Use separate outputs for raw source observation, raw artifact observation,
+comparison and historical byte admission. Record every input hash, exact
+checked implementation revision, commands, outcomes and original failures.
+Run no source evaluator, export, native application or model trial.
+
+## Required controls
+
+| ID | Independently constructed case | Required future outcome |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| H01 | Both original frozen endpoint bundles and GLBs | Eight complete hinge rows each; one shared joint definition; sixteen source-associated endpoint sites; exact hashes admitted only by historical API |
+| H02 | Change source `initial` to a supported in-range literal while retaining artifact initial after provenance rebinding | Source observer returns changed value; artifact observer retains original claim; comparison refuses disagreement |
+| H03 | Change only artifact initial to an in-range different number | Raw claim visible; comparison refuses; historical admission fails bytes |
+| H04 | Paired supported initial change with updated import/program/source bindings | Comparison passes changed value; historical admission refuses; no accepted-revision claim |
+| H05 | Independent source-only, artifact-only and paired changes to each ordered limit | Actual changed fields drive outcomes; no baseline-value substitution |
+| H06 | Boundary equality and zero-width limits, including initial at either endpoint | Inclusive canonical comparisons pass; out-of-range initial and reversed limits refuse |
+| H07 | Equivalent signed deg/rad literals and canonical negative zero | Exact one-round Pi64 conversion; mathematically unequal or adjacent binary64 values refuse when mismatched |
+| H08 | Six signed basis axes; paired axis reversal | Exact sign preserved, normalization identity; no axis-sign canonicalization or motion fitting |
+| H09 | Source zero/nonunit/nonbasis axis, including a valid language nonbasis unit vector | Refusal; unsupported valid expression distinguished from malformed/invalid basis input |
+| H10 | Artifact wrong axis length/type, boolean, NaN/Infinity, tiny nonzero replacement of source zero, or opposite sign | Refusal without normalization, tolerance or repair |
+| H11 | Source parameterized/computed axis, limits or initial; typed Angle parameter with baseline-equivalent default | Unsupported-form refusal; original values never substituted |
+| H12 | Paired joint lexical-name rename retaining key, then key change retaining name | Paths and definition/occurrence IDs follow their separate actual tokens |
+| H13 | Source-only and paired endpoint-site name/key changes | Correct endpoint/site-definition association; no suffix or terminal-name guessing |
+| H14 | Swap ordered endpoints, supply same-object endpoints, or bind one path to another object's site | No sorting; distinct-object requirement; mismatches refuse |
+| H15 | Valid `self.SITE` and direct-part-site paths; private own part with public child site; inaccessible private external site | Supported lexical access passes; invalid/private access refuses |
+| H16 | Unsupported origin endpoint, keyed endpoint traversal, deeper chain, computed SiteRef, scene joint or non-hinge joint | Typed unsupported-form refusal without dropped declarations |
+| H17 | Duplicate/missing/extra joint fields or declarations; member/key collisions with sites/parts/implicit `origin`/`frame`; constructor shadowing | Ambiguity or unsupported binding refuses before expected values are produced |
+| H18 | Site missing required field, nonliteral/empty interface, negative/computed size, unequal interface or canonical size | Explicit source compatibility refusal; pose expressions remain unobserved rather than evaluated |
+| H19 | Reorder keyed input, insert/delete supported keys, direct final-membership override and literal keys containing dots/quotes | Complete set derived from actual keys; no fixed count, order-based identity or naïve dotted-path splitting |
+| H20 | Change unrelated source geometry or the original length parameter; independently change ownership/follow/motion metadata | No hinge values inferred from these fields; only explicit structural/source-binding obligations may refuse; no full-source or other-component pass is claimed |
+| H21 | Missing/extra/duplicate joint rows, duplicate object identity, incorrect owning class or source span | Complete set/association refuses; node and joint-row reordering alone passes |
+| H22 | Stale/missing/contradictory source hash, import digest, program manifest/revision, repeated node/source mapping or definition claim | Source/program binding refusal; display path alone cannot authorize comparison |
+| H23 | Observe artifacts with no direct site/definition/span table | Missing direct authority remains explicit; derived site associations are never relabeled artifact fields |
+| H24 | Truncated/misaligned GLB, duplicate JSON key, wrong JSON shape, excessive bytes/tokens/objects/hinges/sites/depth | Typed structural/resource refusal; no leaked host exception or partial qualified result |
+| H25 | Long numeric lexeme/exponent, adjusted-exponent limits, overflow and underflow boundary | Bound work before numeric allocation; implement exact declared canonical policy or refuse explicitly |
+| H26 | Historical file missing, wrong size/hash, symbolic link, symlink loop, path escape or permission error | Bounded typed I/O/admission refusal; no ambient/network fallback |
+| H27 | Changed supported raw source/artifact supplied to first three interfaces | Inspectable as changed inputs; historical flag remains false and unrelated qualification flags absent/false |
+| H28 | Nontrivial site pose/geometry or motion change that leaves observed hinge fields equal | Explicitly remains outside this declaration comparison; successful field agreement cannot claim endpoint world alignment or physical validity |
+
+## Review acceptance
+
+Review the code's actual field paths, lexical/name/key handling, numeric
+conversion, error boundaries and dependency admission in addition to executing
+the cases. Cases may require multiple independent assertions; reporting a
+single high count cannot replace their coverage or recorded failures. A future
+implementation may use extra tests to resolve a concrete finding, but may not
+weaken the frozen comparison policy or expand its advertised support without
+a reviewed version change.
+
+Keep schema/contract validation, fixed-input inspection, implementation tests
+and real product/trial qualification separate in all reported results.

+# C260 field origins and association limits
+
+The [contract](CONTRACT.md) observes declaration metadata. Source values and
+artifact claims are separate inputs. Every future source observation must
+retain the actual filename, SHA-256 and integer UTF-8 byte interval
+`[startByte, endByteExclusive)`. Every artifact claim must retain the actual
+artifact SHA-256 and JSON pointer. Association does not turn an absent direct
+artifact field into an observation.
+
+## Field mapping
+
+| Field | Independent source origin | Actual GLB origin and limit |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Hinge occurrence ID | Owning root/ordinary/generated occurrence keys plus the joint's literal member key | `/extras/ontokin/joints/i/element_id`; compared as a complete array |
+| Hinge display path | Actual lexical occurrence/member names and correctly quoted keyed steps | `/extras/ontokin/joints/i/path`; not sufficient without full identity/class association |
+| Hinge definition ID | Owning class definition identity plus joint key | No direct field; source-derived association through the mapped owning object/class and joint key |
+| Hinge declaration span | Full actual `joint ... : hinge { ... }` byte span | Absent; object spans cannot be relabeled joint spans |
+| Hinge kind | Actual declaration type token `hinge` | `/extras/ontokin/joints/i/kind` |
+| Parent endpoint | Actual `parent` expression, lexical member/part/site lookup, terminal site key and defining class | `/extras/ontokin/joints/i/parent_site`, a path claim only |
+| Child endpoint | Actual `child` expression and its separate lexical part/site lookup | `/extras/ontokin/joints/i/child_site`, a path claim only; do not reorder endpoints |
+| Endpoint owning object IDs | The source occurrences on which the resolved sites are declared | Object node `path`, `element_id`, `class_name`, `source_mapping` and corresponding program occurrence claims |
+| Endpoint site occurrence IDs | Actual endpoint object ID plus the terminal site's literal key | Absent as direct site IDs; associate the actual endpoint path with the independently derived site map |
+| Endpoint site definition IDs/spans | Declaring source class identity, site key and site declaration bytes | Absent; no site table exists in either bound artifact |
+| Endpoint interface/size | Literal site `interface` and `size`, checked for equal interface and canonical nonnegative size | Absent; retain as source-only compatibility facts |
+| Endpoint site pose | The source `pose` assignment byte witness only | No direct site-pose field; value/frame/orientation are unobserved in this profile |
+| Axis components | Three literal numeric tokens in the actual `vec3` expression, admitted signed-basis subset | `/extras/ontokin/joints/i/axis`; preserve sign and compare exact canonical components |
+| Axis reference frame | Adopted hinge convention: the resolved **parent site's** axes | No separate axis-frame field; it is not inferred from node/world rotation |
+| Lower and upper limits | The two ordered actual Angle literals in `range`, their signs and deg/rad factors | `/extras/ontokin/joints/i/limits/0` and `/1`, canonical radians |
+| Initial coordinate | The actual initial Angle literal and unit factor | `/extras/ontokin/joints/i/initial`, canonical radians; not an animation sample |
+| Source/program identity | Actual bytes, exact import digest and independently constructed canonical bundle manifest/revision | `/extras/ontokin/source`, `/extras/ontokin/program` and all repeated node/source-map claims |
+
+Ownership, following, scene-root indices, node transforms, animation channels,
+producer sidecars and C255 expected records are not origins for any hinge
+value. Occurrence containment is used to identify where a declaration is
+instantiated; it does not create a mechanical relationship by itself.
+
+## Concrete frozen association
+
+The source defines one `Finger.flex` hinge member and instantiates it three
+times under `first` and five times under `second`. The same definition is
+therefore associated with eight distinct hinge occurrences. The selected
+middle finger's length edit changes neither this member nor its literal
+hinge fields.
+
+| Concept | Original first middle finger |
+| --- | --- |
+| Owning object occurrence | `["keyed-rack","demo","first","fingers","middle"]` |
+| Joint occurrence | `["keyed-rack","demo","first","fingers","middle","flex"]` |
+| Joint definition | `["package","example.hinges","hinges","definitions","finger","flex"]` |
+| Parent site occurrence | `["keyed-rack","demo","first","fingers","middle","pivot"]` |
+| Parent site definition | `["package","example.hinges","hinges","definitions","finger","pivot"]` |
+| Child site occurrence | `["keyed-rack","demo","first","fingers","middle","blade","base"]` |
+| Child site definition | `["package","example.hinges","hinges","definitions","blade","base"]` |
+| Actual artifact row | `/extras/ontokin/joints/1` in each original artifact |
+| Parent/child path claims | `first.fingers["middle"].pivot` and `first.fingers["middle"].blade.base` |
+| Axis/limits/initial | `[0,0,1]` in parent-site axes; `[-0.7853981633974483,0.7853981633974483]` radians; `0` radians |
+
+The row index is an observed location, not an identity rule. Reordering rows
+changes pointers while retaining identities. All sixteen endpoint site
+occurrences are source-associated; none is an embedded GLB site record.
+
+[BASELINE-INSPECTION.json](BASELINE-INSPECTION.json) retains the actual source
+witnesses, the manually derived eight occurrence/definition associations and
+every actual joint row from each bound GLB. Its fixed-input inspection is
+evidence for designing the contract. A future implementation must derive
+changed source values independently instead of loading this baseline as an
+answer table.

+# C260: finite hinge-declaration observation contract
+
+C260 defines what a later independent reader may say about the existing
+keyed-rack hinges. A hinge joins two named attachment sites and declares an
+axis, angular limits and an initial angle. Those declarations are separate
+from object ownership, spatial following and recorded motion.
+
+This increment contains a **contract and input inspection only**. It adds no
+hinge reader and establishes no hinge implementation qualification. It follows
+the [C258 integrated next task](../localized-repair-c258/INTEGRATED-NEXT-TASK.md)
+under [scope #247](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/issues/247).
+
+## Selected boundary
+
+The future reader will derive class-member hinge declarations from the two
+supplied `.ok` files and compare the corresponding rows in the actual GLB JSON.
+The supported subset uses literal signed coordinate axes and literal angular
+limits/initial values. It resolves ordered endpoint references to declared
+sites on the current object or a direct ordinary part. It retains complete
+occurrence, definition and source-byte associations.
+
+The existing artifacts contain eight joint rows at each endpoint. They contain
+no site table, joint-definition table or joint/site source-span records.
+Therefore site identity and definition associations come from the supplied
+source; site poses and the resulting world motion remain unobserved here.
+No missing artifact field is filled with a producer sidecar or an expected
+semantic record.
+
+## Read in order
+
+1. [Version 0.1.0 contract](CONTRACT.md): authority, supported forms, comparison
+   policy, refusals and implementation gate.
+2. [Field origins](FIELD-ORIGINS.md): source witnesses, actual JSON pointers and
+   unavailable artifact provenance.
+3. [Input bindings](INPUTS.json) and [baseline inspection](BASELINE-INSPECTION.json):
+   exact hashes, 37 source witnesses, eight source-derived joint associations
+   and the 16 actual rows across the two artifacts.
+4. [Independent control plan](CONTROL-PLAN.md): required future checks; these
+   are planned cases, not passed implementation tests.
+5. [Next bounded task](NEXT-TASK.md): implement and independently check this
+   finite reader after the reviewed contract is integrated and handed off.
+
+## Evidence and limitations
+
+The inspected baseline is published main
+`003b3a7827486405c3d00f039c1c9746c9be75fc`, tree
+`325c7e50b42000e7c2976e3dd8c3babcec2649ba`. The inspection checked twelve source,
+specification and artifact bindings and read the actual GLB JSON bytes without
+importing the product parser, evaluator, exporter or C255 expected records.
+It confirms that the proposed subset covers both frozen endpoints. It does
+not exercise the future control plan.
+
+The [C253 protocol](../localized-repair-c253/README.md), earlier component
+implementations, all numerical tolerances and prior failures retain their
+existing meanings. Complete semantic records, site-frame transport, motion
+agreement, revision authenticity, invalid-edit atomicity, clean rebuilds,
+native/model trials and comparative advantage remain separate unmet gates.
+
+Applicable integration checks are independent contract review, exact binding
+verification, the unchanged C253 manifest check and the repository documentation
+preservation/link check. The integrator records their actual revision and
+outcome separately. A specification review cannot substitute for a future
+implementation check.

+"""Record fixed C260 design inputs and direct GLB metadata for human review.
+
+This one-off inspection has no product observer API and accepts no candidate.
+It imports no OntoKin implementation or expected-answer module.
+"""
+from pathlib import Path
+import hashlib
+import json
+import platform
+import struct
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from fractions import Fraction
+
+REPO = Path('/workspace/scratch/78ebb05e03a4/OntoKin')
+OUT = Path('/workspace/scratch/a827454f4cb7/contract-draft/docs/engineering/localized-repair-c260')
+EVIDENCE = Path('/workspace/scratch/a827454f4cb7/evidence/contract-author')
+PROOF = 'docs/engineering/semantic-export-c210/evidence/proof'
+paths = [
+    'docs/language-design/OK-LANG-001-core-language-specification.md',
+    'docs/language-design/OK-LANG-002-pinned-modules-and-keyed-assembly-construction.md',
+    'docs/engineering/OK-ENG-002-3d-scene-animation-export-and-visual-validation.md',
+    'docs/engineering/semantic-export-c210/CONTRACT.md',
+    'docs/engineering/localized-repair-c253/corpus.json',
+    'docs/engineering/localized-repair-c257/ownership.py',
+    'docs/engineering/localized-repair-c258/INTEGRATED-NEXT-TASK.md',
+    *[PROOF + '/' + p for p in ['before.main.ok', 'after.main.ok', 'hinges.ok', 'before.glb', 'after.glb']],
+]
+def digest(raw):
+    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
+def dump(path, data):
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n')
+def witness(path, text, occurrence=0):
+    raw = (REPO / path).read_bytes()
+    term = text.encode()
+    positions = []
+    start = 0
+    while (start := raw.find(term, start)) >= 0:
+        positions.append(start)
+        start += len(term)
+    assert len(positions) > occurrence, (path, text)
+    start = positions[occurrence]
+    return {'path': path, 'sourceSha256': digest(raw), 'startByte': start,
+            'endByteExclusive': start + len(term), 'text': text,
+            'selectedOccurrence': occurrence, 'matchingOccurrences': len(positions)}
+
+revision = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(REPO), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
+tree = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(REPO), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}'], text=True).strip()
+assert revision == '003b3a7827486405c3d00f039c1c9746c9be75fc'
+assert tree == '325c7e50b42000e7c2976e3dd8c3babcec2649ba'
+files = [{'path': p, 'bytes': (REPO / p).stat().st_size, 'sha256': digest((REPO / p).read_bytes())} for p in paths]
+corpus = json.loads((REPO / 'docs/engineering/localized-repair-c253/corpus.json').read_text())
+matching = {}
+for name, binding in corpus['files'].items():
+    match = next((f for f in files if f['path'] == binding['path']), None)
+    if match:
+        assert all(match[k] == binding[k] for k in ['path', 'bytes', 'sha256'])
+        matching[name] = dict(binding)
+dump(OUT / 'INPUTS.json', {'schema': 'ontokin.c260.contract-inputs/0.1',
+    'contractVersion': '0.1.0', 'sourceRevision': revision, 'sourceTree': tree,
+    'dependencyPolicy': 'Only pinned C257 lexical/module/occurrence identity utilities may be reused; no hinge values from ownership/follow/motion or producer expectations.',
+    'files': files, 'c253MatchingPins': matching,
+    'historicalAdmission': {'before': ['before.main.ok', 'hinges.ok', 'before.glb'],
+                            'after': ['after.main.ok', 'hinges.ok', 'after.glb']},
+    'notAuthoritativeForHinges': ['producer semantic sidecars', 'C255 expected records',
+        'sampled motion', 'ownership or follow edges'],
+    'implementationPresent': False})
+
+hinges = PROOF + '/hinges.ok'
+witnesses = {
+    'libraryModule': witness(hinges, 'module Hinges @ "hinges";'),
+    'fingerClass': witness(hinges, 'public class Finger @ "finger" {'),
+    'bladeClass': witness(hinges, 'private class Blade @ "blade" {'),
+    'jointDeclaration': witness(hinges, 'public joint flex @ "flex": hinge {\n        parent = self.pivot;\n        child = self.blade.base;\n        axis = vec3(0, 0, 1);\n        limits = range(-45[deg], 45[deg]);\n        initial = 0[rad];\n    }'),
+    'parentExpression': witness(hinges, 'parent = self.pivot;'),
+    'childExpression': witness(hinges, 'child = self.blade.base;'),
+    'axisExpression': witness(hinges, 'axis = vec3(0, 0, 1);'),
+    'limitsExpression': witness(hinges, 'limits = range(-45[deg], 45[deg]);'),
+    'initialExpression': witness(hinges, 'initial = 0[rad];'),
+    'parentSite': witness(hinges, 'public site pivot @ "pivot" {\n        pose = pose(self.frame, vec3(0[m], 0[m], 0[m]), quat(1, 0, 0, 0));\n        interface = "hinged.part";\n        size = 0[m];\n    }'),
+    'childSite': witness(hinges, 'public site base @ "base" {\n        pose = pose(self.frame, vec3(-self.length / 2, 0[m], 0[m]), quat(1, 0, 0, 0));\n        interface = "hinged.part";\n        size = 0[m];\n    }'),
+    'childPart': witness(hinges, 'private part blade @ "blade": Blade {\n        length = self.length;\n        tint = self.tint;\n    }'),
+    'helperKeyLower': witness(hinges, '"lower": vec3(0[m], -spacing, 0[m])'),
+    'helperKeyMiddle': witness(hinges, '"middle": vec3(0[m], 0[m], 0[m])'),
+    'helperKeyUpper': witness(hinges, '"upper": vec3(0[m], spacing, 0[m])'),
+}
+for endpoint in ['before', 'after']:
+    path = PROOF + '/' + endpoint + '.main.ok'
+    witnesses[endpoint + 'EntryModule'] = witness(path, 'module KeyedRack @ "keyed-rack";')
+    witnesses[endpoint + 'Scene'] = witness(path, 'scene Demo @ "demo" {')
+    witnesses[endpoint + 'FirstRoot'] = witness(path, 'object first @ "first": Rack {')
+    witnesses[endpoint + 'SecondRoot'] = witness(path, 'object second @ "second": Rack {')
+    witnesses[endpoint + 'Generator'] = witness(path, 'public parts fingers @ "fingers": mech.Finger for (key, offset) in self.mounts')
+    witnesses[endpoint + 'DefaultMembership'] = witness(path, 'public param mounts @ "mounts": Keyed<Vec3<Length>> = mech.three_mounts(0.6[m]);')
+    for key in ['bottom', 'lower', 'middle', 'upper', 'top']:
+        witnesses[endpoint + 'SecondKey' + key.title()] = witness(path, '"' + key + '":')
+
+canonical_45deg = float(Fraction(45) * Fraction.from_float(float.fromhex('0x1.921fb54442d18p+1')) / 180)
+assert canonical_45deg.hex() == '0x1.921fb54442d18p-1'
+source_rows = []
+for root, keys in [('first', ['lower', 'middle', 'upper']),
+                   ('second', ['bottom', 'lower', 'middle', 'upper', 'top'])]:
+    for key in keys:
+        oid = ['keyed-rack', 'demo', root, 'fingers', key]
+        opath = root + '.fingers[' + json.dumps(key) + ']'
+        source_rows.append({'path': opath + '.flex', 'elementId': oid + ['flex'],
+            'definitionId': ['package', 'example.hinges', 'hinges', 'definitions', 'finger', 'flex'],
+            'owningOccurrenceId': oid, 'owningClassDefinitionId': ['package', 'example.hinges', 'hinges', 'definitions', 'finger'],
+            'kind': 'hinge', 'parentSitePath': opath + '.pivot', 'parentSiteId': oid + ['pivot'],
+            'parentSiteDefinitionId': ['package', 'example.hinges', 'hinges', 'definitions', 'finger', 'pivot'],
+            'childSitePath': opath + '.blade.base', 'childSiteId': oid + ['blade', 'base'],
+            'childSiteDefinitionId': ['package', 'example.hinges', 'hinges', 'definitions', 'blade', 'base'],
+            'axis': [0, 0, 1], 'axisFrame': 'parent-site', 'limitsRad': [-canonical_45deg, canonical_45deg],
+            'initialRad': 0.0, 'sourceOnlySiteCompatibility': {'interface': 'hinged.part', 'sizeM': 0.0},
+            'derivation': 'Read joint/site/member keys from actual hinges.ok; expand three helper keys for first and five direct override keys for second; no product/expected module imported.'})
+artifacts = {}
+for endpoint in ['before', 'after']:
+    path = PROOF + '/' + endpoint + '.glb'
+    raw = (REPO / path).read_bytes()
+    magic, version, total = struct.unpack_from('<4sII', raw)
+    assert (magic, version, total) == (b'glTF', 2, len(raw))
+    size, kind = struct.unpack_from('<II', raw, 12)
+    assert kind == 0x4E4F534A
+    doc = json.loads(raw[20:20+size])
+    meta = doc['extras']['ontokin']
+    joints = meta['joints']
+    direct = []
+    by_path = {row['path']: row for row in source_rows}
+    for i, row in enumerate(joints):
+        assert set(row) == {'path', 'element_id', 'kind', 'parent_site', 'child_site', 'axis', 'limits', 'initial'}
+        expected = by_path[row['path']]
+        assert row['element_id'] == expected['elementId']
+        assert row['kind'] == expected['kind']
+        assert row['parent_site'] == expected['parentSitePath']
+        assert row['child_site'] == expected['childSitePath']
+        assert row['axis'] == expected['axis']
+        assert row['limits'] == expected['limitsRad']
+        assert row['initial'] == expected['initialRad']
+        direct.append({'pointer': '/extras/ontokin/joints/' + str(i), 'value': row})
+    assert len(joints) == len(source_rows) == 8
+    assert len(doc['nodes']) == 18
+    assert 'sites' not in meta and 'definitions' not in meta
+    assert all(n['extras']['ontokin']['kind'] == 'object' for n in doc['nodes'])
+    artifacts[endpoint] = {'path': path, 'sha256': digest(raw), 'bytes': len(raw),
+        'jointRows': direct, 'jointCount': len(joints), 'objectNodeCount': len(doc['nodes']),
+        'sourceBindingPointers': ['/extras/ontokin/source', '/extras/ontokin/program'],
+        'programRevision': meta['program']['revision'],
+        'directSiteTablePresent': False, 'jointDefinitionFieldsPresent': False,
+        'jointSourceSpanFieldsPresent': False,
+        'note': 'Endpoint site paths are direct artifact claims; site identities/definitions are source associations, not artifact site records.'}
+dump(OUT / 'BASELINE-INSPECTION.json', {'schema': 'ontokin.c260.baseline-design-inspection/0.1',
+    'sourceRevision': revision, 'sourceTree': tree, 'purpose': 'Fixed input inspection supporting contract review; not a candidate reader or product qualification.',
+    'sourceWitnesses': witnesses, 'independentSourceRows': source_rows, 'actualArtifacts': artifacts,
+    'numericDerivation': {'pi64': '0x1.921fb54442d18p+1', 'angle': 'round_binary64(exact_decimal(45) * exact_binary64(Pi64) / 180)',
+        'angleHex': '0x1.921fb54442d18p-1', 'signedBasisAxisNormalization': 'identity; no sign canonicalization'},
+    'executedChecks': {'inputFileBindings': len(files), 'sourceWitnesses': len(witnesses), 'artifactJointRows': 16,
+        'sourceDistinctJointOccurrences': 8, 'matchingC253Bindings': len(matching)},
+    'implementationQualification': False, 'futureControlPlanExecuted': False})
+dump(EVIDENCE / 'EXECUTION.json', {'command': [sys.executable, __file__], 'python': sys.version,
+    'platform': platform.platform(), 'sourceRevision': revision, 'sourceTree': tree,
+    'productImports': [], 'productExecutions': 0, 'nativeStarts': 0, 'modelCalls': 0,
+    'outputFiles': ['INPUTS.json', 'BASELINE-INSPECTION.json'],
+    'passed': True, 'meaning': 'One-off static design-input inspection only; future contract controls unrun.'})
+print(json.dumps({'passed': True, 'inputFiles': len(files), 'sourceWitnesses': len(witnesses), 'actualJointRows': 16}))

+# Independent C260 contract review
+
+**Decision: approve the corrected contract for integration as documentation.**
+No hinge-observer implementation or implementation qualification is approved.
+The reviewer did not author the contract. The exact seven approved files are
+bound in [REVIEW-BINDING.json](REVIEW-BINDING.json). The approved contract SHA-256
+is `39bf90c51256cb392b0b639c36f3325c76f8919bbea4e3e572937e9834f8cd6c`.
+
+## Basis for the decision
+
+The finite subset covers both frozen C253 endpoints: eight hinge occurrences
+share one class-member definition, with sixteen source-associated endpoint
+sites. The declared axis is a signed coordinate basis; limits and initial
+values are literal Angles. The contract derives source facts independently,
+keeps GLB rows as claims until comparison, and reserves historical admission
+for exact original source/artifact hashes.
+
+The review independently read the adopted core, construction and transport
+rules, all three actual `.ok` inputs and both actual GLB byte streams. It did
+not import the product parser, evaluator, exporter, C255 expected values,
+producer sidecars or candidate reader code. The reviewer constructed occurrence
+and definition identities directly from source module, class, root, collection,
+literal-key, part, site and joint declarations. Actual artifact values and
+source mappings agree with those fixed-input associations.
+
+| Review obligation | Observed result |
+| --- | --- |
+| Exact source/specification/dependency/artifact bindings | All twelve match; five matching C253 pins also agree |
+| Source byte witnesses | All 37 source hashes, byte slices and selected occurrences match |
+| Hinge associations | All eight source-derived rows agree with all sixteen artifact rows across before/after |
+| Object associations | Both complete eighteen-object maps match source; every repeated node/program mapping agrees |
+| Declaration and definition spans | All 36 object instances across both artifacts identify the actual source class and declaration bytes |
+| Canonical program identity | Both manifests/revisions independently recompute from exact source bytes |
+| Missing artifact authority | No direct site table or joint/site definition/span fields are invented |
+| Numeric meaning | Exact decimal × exact binary64 Pi64 / 180, rounded once; original 45 degrees gives `0x1.921fb54442d18p-1` radians |
+| Future controls | All 28 listed cases remain explicitly planned and unrun |
+| Final freeze | All seven final file hashes unchanged after inspection |
+
+The [fixed-input inspection](INSPECTION.json) contains 242 passing assertions;
+the [object-source mapping inspection](MAPPING-SPANS.json) contains 142.
+These are document and fixed-byte audit assertions, not 384 implementation
+tests. The source baseline remains `003b3a7827486405c3d00f039c1c9746c9be75fc`,
+tree `325c7e50b42000e7c2976e3dd8c3babcec2649ba`; later root lease work changed
+coordination state without changing any bound input.
+
+## Findings corrected before approval
+
+**R1 — authored stable keys need their adopted domain.** The first draft used
+a generic 512-character text cap without separately imposing the adopted
+ASCII 64-character stable-key grammar. Its H19 case also mentioned quotes as
+if they were legal key content. The corrected contract preserves
+`[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}`, adds explicit invalid-key refusal, and limits
+the larger cap to other consumed text. Legal dots remain opaque key content.
+
+**R2 — empty keyed input was ambiguous.** The first draft did not state a
+minimum input cardinality, while pinned C257 utilities reject an empty keyed
+literal. The corrected contract explicitly selects 1–64 entries. An empty
+typed keyed value remains valid language syntax but unsupported by this finite
+observer. H19 now requires that distinction. Original draft files, hashes and
+findings are retained in the author's attempt01 evidence.
+
+## Numeric vector for the future H07 check
+
+The already-required one-round rule can be distinguished from a common
+premature-rounding implementation with `1.1[deg]`. Independent exact rational
+arithmetic gives binary64 `0x1.3a8cdb28e1358p-6`. Computing
+`float("1.1") * (Pi64 / 180)` instead gives
+`0x1.3a8cdb28e1359p-6`. This vector is recorded in the inspection report to make
+H07 concrete during implementation. It is a review arithmetic result; no
+candidate implementation has been run on it.
+
+## Limits and remaining gates
+
+The contract explicitly leaves site-pose evaluation, world alignment, combined
+pose authority, motion, complete semantics, accepted revisions, rebuilds,
+native behavior and model comparisons unqualified. Its equality policy is
+limited to the literal/basis subset and does not import the follow component's
+quaternion tolerance or claim general exporter accuracy.
+
+Root still owns applicable documentation preservation, guarded publication,
+resulting-main checks, complete archive restoration and the confirmed saved
+handoff. The reviewer's own inspection mistakes are preserved separately in
+[REVIEWER-ATTEMPTS.md](REVIEWER-ATTEMPTS.md); they caused no contract changes or
+product executions.

+1. An initial read-only GLB probe attempted `extras.ontokin.objects` and raised

+2. A follow-up probe treated that mapping as a list and raised `KeyError: 0`.
+   Inspecting its type showed a dictionary keyed by display path. No input
+   file was written or modified by either probe.
+3. The first complete fixed-input inspection zipped the source-derived rows in
+   canonical key order against the author's explanatory row list in literal
+   order. It stopped at `second.fingers["upper"].flex`. Row order is explicitly
+   not identity in the contract, so this was a reviewer assertion error. The
+   corrected audit compares those records by complete path and requires a
+   unique, complete set. Its original script, failure report and logs remain
+   under `attempt01/`. The author files were unchanged by this correction.
+
+The corrected inspection passes 242 assertions. A separate source-span audit
+passes 142 assertions. Neither executes a hinge implementation or the planned
+future control matrix.
